name: 表示列の追加・除外と順序変更ダイアログ
prompt:
Recreate only the complete Salesforce modal shown in the primary original crop. Match its 814:537 aspect ratio (about 1.52:1), rounded white dialog, subtle border/shadow, centered dark-navy title, horizontal dividers, two-column layout and bottom-right actions. Exclude the dimmed contact list and page background. No Japanese mock exists for this source.

Centered title: 「表示する項目を選択」. Beneath it, create two equal bordered list panels with bold headings: left 「利用可能な項目」 and right 「表示する項目」. Preserve six unselected rows in each panel, in this exact order. Left: 「取引先 ID」, 「取引先所有者の別名」, 「取引先所有者: 名」, 「取引先所有者: 姓」, 「親取引先」, 「取引先: 取引先ソース」. Right: 「氏名」, 「取引先名」, 「電話」, 「メール」, 「役職」, 「取引先責任者の別名」. Keep all rows neutral gray with no highlighted selection.

Between the list panels, place two blue triangular transfer controls: right-pointing arrow aligned near the top of the lists and left-pointing arrow below it. To the right of the visible-fields list, place blue up and down triangles for reordering, one above the other. Preserve their source placement and sizes.

A thin divider separates the footer. Align 「キャンセル」 as an outlined white button and 「保存」 as a solid blue button at the lower right. Both buttons are enabled. Keep the source’s generous modal padding, compact list rows, dark-navy title, black headings, gray row text and Salesforce blue actions. Do not add a close icon, extra fields, rows or page context.
reviewNotes: LH09-0257 v001 visual review against the assigned 814x537 Salesforce modal crop. The Japanese candidate preserves the centered title, both six-row lists and their order, the transfer arrows between lists, reorder arrows to the right, and enabled Cancel/Save footer actions. Side-by-side comparison at source scale shows close panel, divider, spacing and button placement; no material geometry or content defect found. Source-only localization because no Japanese mock exists. Status: reviewed for image-generation fidelity only; this does not claim native editability or application behavior.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
